svg.title: The city ends. Its light doesn’t. How skyglow reaches an observing site.
svg.desc: A conceptual illustrated mountain landscape shows a small nearby village and a much more distant city. Representative solid amber and blue paths carry artificial light upward into a shared region of atmosphere along a telescope’s line of sight. Air molecules and aerosols scatter a small fraction toward the observer, shown by a dashed ivory arrow entering the telescope’s objective. Natural sky brightness plus nearby and distant skyglow contribute to the total sky background. Paths are illustrative and not to scale; colors identify sources, not their spectra or relative brightness. Background art is an illustration, not a photograph of an actual site.
